title: ADR-0028: sandbox-runtime replaces hand-written seatbelt profiles

content.summary: The fleet now confines its processes with **sandbox-runtime (srt)** instead of hand-written seatbelt profiles: each process starts default-deny and reaches only the hosts its settings name.

sections.h: A process moves onto srt in four steps

blocks.text: Each step lands before the next one starts.

items: Write the settings file that names the hosts the process may reach and the paths it may write.
Swap the launcher so it starts the process under `srt-run` instead of `sandbox-exec`.
Run the process for a day and read every denial the log records. Add a host or a path only for a real need.
Delete the old `.sb` profile, so nothing can start the process unconfined.
